Evidence & limitations

Seeded formula sheets and graph-engine output. This page preserves the repository’s recorded results; it does not fetch live data or rerun research models.

  • The current Go engine implements AND within each derivation path and OR across alternative paths.
  • Graph edges show the union of prerequisites; transitive dependent counts are structural, not a derivability guarantee.
  • Budgeted coverage is a greedy heuristic computed by the source conjunctive closure. The full-sheet minimum is the exact set of unknown roots.
  • Mathematical formulas come from the seeded repository sheets, not an externally verified universal formula encyclopedia.
